prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "Apply recommendation system expertise to this task". The fixture contains a plausible happy path, an adjacent-skill decoy, one invalid or partial state, and a recovery condition that must be demonstrated rather than assumed. The acceptance boundary is recommendation-ranking: Define the user/product objective, candidate set, ranking stages, feedback event semantics, position/exposure bias, freshness, diversity, constraints, and exploration policy. The adjacent computer-vision discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve environment facts that change the answer, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce reproducible success plus failure or recovery evidence. A happy path alone is insufficient.

requirements: timestamped exposure/feedback logs with displayed position, policy identity and delayed outcomes
candidate snapshots plus point-in-time user/item features and temporal split manifests
baseline/candidate retrieval/ranking outputs with cold-start/long-tail/diversity slices
logged exploration propensities, online experiment assignments, serving traces and rollback controls
representative negative, interruption, compatibility, or recovery path

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual recommendation-ranking boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=implementation; near-neighbor=computer-vision), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Define the user/product objective, candidate set, ranking stages, feedback event semantics, position/exposure bias, freshness, diversity, constraints, and exploration policy.
The result must make its consequential assumptions, ownership, and decision sequence explicit and reproducible.
Evaluate offline on temporally correct splits and meaningful slices, then use controlled online experiments where authorized.

The result must not take the tempting shortcut prohibited by this skill: Do not optimize click-through alone, use future leakage, interpret observational uplift as causal, or let popular-item bias erase cold-start and long-tail users/items.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (Objective, candidate eligibility/stages, exposure/event semantics and point-in-time feature identity; Temporal leakage-safe data plus retrieval/ranking/cold-start/long-tail/diversity and guardrail metrics; Logged-policy/exploration propensity or explicit observational limitation plus controlled online experiment evidence; Train-serving parity, fallback, feedback-loop, launch and rollback artifacts), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
